homeLead: 榛怡醫務中心兒科專科，專注兒童健康診療。
團隊由經驗豐富的兒科醫師組成，擅長診治小兒常見疾病、呼吸道、內分泌及敏感症的問題。同時提供高端疫苗及兒童保健、成長、語言及心理輔導等服務。
診室環境溫馨童趣，診療細緻耐心，用心守護每一位孩子的健康成長。

about: 榛怡醫務中心於尖沙咀設有兩個服務據點，分別位於美麗華廣場及海洋中心，為兒童及家庭提供一站式兒科內外專科醫療服務。
中心涵蓋多個兒科專科範疇，包括兒童呼吸科、內分泌科、腎科、腦神經科及遺傳科，提供專業的評估、檢查及診斷。團隊同時配備心理學家及語言治療專家，就兒童發展、教育及家庭層面提供全面支援，照顧孩子醫療與發展上的不同需要。
我們十分重視與家長之間清晰透明的溝通，詳細解釋孩子的成長及健康狀況，讓家長掌握完整資訊，從而作出安心、合適的決定，陪伴孩子健康成長。

homeLeadEn: Venco Medical Centre provides specialist paediatric care for children.
Our experienced paediatricians care for common childhood illnesses, respiratory, endocrine, and allergy concerns, with vaccination, growth support, and counselling services.
Warm clinic spaces and attentive care for every child’s healthy growth.
aboutEn: Venco Medical Centre operates two clinics in Tsim Sha Tsui, at Mira Place and Ocean Centre, providing one-stop paediatric medical and surgical specialist care for children and families.

The centre covers a wide range of paediatric subspecialties, including respiratory medicine, endocrinology, nephrology, neurology and clinical genetics, offering professional assessment, examination and diagnosis. The team also includes psychologists and speech therapists, providing comprehensive support across child development, education and family needs.

We place great importance on clear and transparent communication with parents, explaining each child's growth and health in detail, so families have complete information to make confident and well-suited decisions as their children grow.
